step.claimHint: Extracting verifiable names, places, dates and figures
step.clueHint: Clues with confidence level and limits

verifier.verdictScaleHint: Assigned only by humans: the tool provides clues, professionals decide.

verdictDefinition.confirmed: The claim is accurate and supported by evidence.
verdictDefinition.misleading: Contains accurate elements but gives a false impression.
verdictDefinition.out_of_context: Authentic content presented with a date, place or meaning that is not its own.
verdictDefinition.false: The claim is contradicted by the evidence.
verdictDefinition.fabricated: Content created or altered to deceive, including with generative AI.
verdictDefinition.unverifiable: The available elements do not allow a conclusion to date.

profil.installUnavailable: Use the browser menu: “Add to home screen”.

error.account_suspended: This account is suspended. Contact the administrator.
error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your network.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.cannot_change_own_account: You cannot modify your own account.
error.already_exists: An account already exists with this address.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.email_not_confirmed: Email address not confirmed. In Supabase, confirm the account (Authentication → Users).
error.email_not_authorized: Supabase's email service refuses this address: configure an SMTP server or create the account manually.
error.profile_missing: This account has no MASO profile. Ask the administrator to create it (see the Supabase setup).
error.configuration: Supabase is misconfigured (key, migrations or email provider). Check the .env file and the setup.
error.no_account: No MASO account is linked to this address. Check the address or ask the administrator for an invitation.

onboarding.s1Text: Image, video, link or text received on Facebook or WhatsApp: MASO analyses it and gives you clues, never an automatic verdict.
onboarding.s2Text: Evidence, sources, experts and official figures gathered in one case. The fact-checker proposes, the editor-in-chief validates and publishes.
onboarding.s3Text: Install the app: your cases, the directory and statistics stay available without network.
